1.web: The earth is Yahweh’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.
1.asv: The earth is Jehovah’s, and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein.

2.web: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.
2.asv: For he hath founded it upon the seas, And established it upon the floods.

3.web: Who may ascend to Yahweh’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?
3.asv: Who shall ascend into the hill of Jehovah? And who shall stand in his holy place?

4.web: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.
4.asv: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; Who hath not lifted up his soul unto falsehood, And hath not sworn deceitfully.

5.web: He shall receive a blessing from Yahweh, righteousness from the God of his salvation.
5.asv: He shall receive a blessing from Jehovah, And righteousness from the God of his salvation.

6.web: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob. Selah.
6.asv: This is the generation of them that seek after him, That seek thy face, even Jacob. [Selah

7.web: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
7.asv: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; And be ye lifted up, ye everlasting doors: And the King of glory will come in.

8.web: Who is the King of glory? Yahweh strong and mighty, Yahweh mighty in battle.
8.asv: Who is the King of glory? Jehovah strong and mighty, Jehovah mighty in battle.

9.web: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
9.asv: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; Yea, lift them up, ye everlasting doors: And the King of glory will come in.

10.web: Who is this King of glory? Yahweh of Armies is the King of glory! Selah.
10.asv: Who is this King of glory? Jehovah of hosts, He is the King of glory. [Selah
